_note: TEMPLATE ONLY — not data. Fill every TO_FILL value with real a-cappella
recordings before building. A catalog pointing at placeholder paths is
rejected by the loader; no library is built from this file as-is.
Material paths are resolved relative to THIS file's directory, so keep
the catalog and its audio in one folder tree and invoke the build from
anywhere. Each singer may list several takes; they are merged into one
prototype. gender must be exactly 'male' or 'female' — it selects the
candidate pool at query time, so a typo silently strands the singer.
v1 accepts clean a-cappella takes only: no accompaniment detection and no
source separation. Do not point this at accompanied material.
Build: python -m voicematch.cli build --catalog catalog.json --out lib/
(the default encoder is hubert; use --encoder hash only for tests)
